assumptions: Synthetic retail demonstration; hand-authored item totals, not observed customer or benchmark data.
Fixed UTC daily buckets use right endpoints; available_at equals event_time by synthetic assumption, not observed publication history.
The three-day repetition period is illustrative; no real retail seasonality has been established.
Point-only seasonal baseline; no calibrated intervals, joint paths, event probabilities or causal claims.
No inventory, returns, deliveries or stockout mechanism is represented; item totals alone do not establish availability.
